payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Complete (yes) if the supports together establish that the source background has been replaced by a recognizable basketball-court setting; court context may be established by the visible playing surface/lines together with basketball equipment, and neither a single support report nor a disagreement alone is decisive. Partial if there is evidenced basketball-related background progress but the background is not recognizably a court. Absent (no) if there is no visible requested progress. Unknown if the saved evidence cannot resolve whether requested progress occurred; do not convert conflicting reports or uncertainty into a fabricated failure or completion. Unchanged foreground subject matter is irrelevant.
node.binding: Target: The background is visibly a basketball court, with recognizable court features such as a playing surface and court markings or basketball equipment.. Reference: The input image and the requested background change in R1..
